title: Testing of piping.
officialText:
Before any system of piping is put in service or concealed, it shall be tested to ensure that it is gas tight.
Testing, inspection and purging of piping systems shall comply with Section 406.
SECTION FGC 405
PIPING BENDS AND CHANGES IN DIRECTION
